motivation: v0.67 showed that the formal sigma8 tangent response is dominated by high-k support: the 4...8 h/Mpc shell supplied about three quarters of the signed response on the primary redshift grid, the 8...16 h/Mpc shell still supplied about one fifth, and the sigma8 integral was not closed at 16 h/Mpc. v0.68 therefore does not extend sigma8 farther into the UV. Instead it returns to the previously preregistered v0.63 low-k grid and directly maps the matter and Weyl power responses there. This is a result-informed theory follow-up and does not alter the historical v0.65, v0.66, or v0.67 FAIL classifications.

source_results.known_v067_uv_result: The formal sigma8 response is UV/high-k dominated on the tested linear CLASS spectrum and the 8...16 h/Mpc shell remains non-negligible.
source_results.policy: v0.68 is not a rescue of the sigma8 result. It asks a different physical question: what does the frozen eta=0 memory tangent do directly to low-k matter and Weyl power on a grid that predates the v0.67 outcome?

frozen_physical_model.memory_forcing_construction: unchanged v0.39/v0.63 positive-Drude construction with control order 512 and primary order 1024

fixed_grid.provenance: Exactly the RSD diagnostic grid preregistered in v063/predata_theory_target_selection.json before the v0.63 result.
fixed_grid.interpretation: Low-k/quasi-linear theory diagnostic grid. No claim is made that every point is observationally linear for every survey or redshift.

response_definitions.lambda_consensus: Arithmetic mean of g over the four fixed tangent amplitudes, used only after the preregistered lambda-affinity audit.
response_definitions.matter_evaluation: CLASS pk_lin evaluated directly at each fixed (k,z) point.
response_definitions.weyl_evaluation: CLASS linear Weyl power from get_Weyl_pk_and_k_and_z, interpolated in log power over (log k,z) to the fixed grid. The same interpolation is applied to native matter power and compared with direct pk_lin as a preregistered interpolation audit.

lambda_affinity_metric.definition: For field X in {matter,Weyl} and each fixed lambda, epsilon_X(lambda)=sqrt[sum_grid (g_X(lambda)-gbar_X)^2 / sum_grid gbar_X^2], with equal weight for all 42 predeclared grid points. The gate uses max_lambda epsilon_X(lambda).
lambda_affinity_metric.reason: This tests whether the externally forced tangent response is lambda-invariant on the low-k map without selecting favorable k or z points after seeing the result.

secondary_reports_no_gate: mean d ln P_m/d eta and d ln P_Weyl/d eta at all 42 fixed grid points
response by each of the four fixed tangent amplitudes at every grid point
per-redshift RMS and maximum absolute matter and Weyl response over the six fixed k values
per-k RMS and maximum absolute matter and Weyl response over the seven fixed redshifts
fraction of grid points with positive and negative consensus response for each field
sign-concordance fraction between matter and Weyl consensus responses
Pearson correlation between matter and Weyl consensus responses over the fixed grid
RMS amplitude ratio of Weyl to matter consensus response
largest absolute matter-Weyl response difference and its fixed-grid location

sign_topology_report.precedence: EXACT_ZERO_PRESENT first; otherwise MATTER_WEYL_SIGN_SPLIT_PRESENT if any point has opposite signs; otherwise coherent negative or coherent positive if both fields have that sign everywhere; otherwise MIXED_WITHOUT_POINTWISE_SIGN_SPLIT.

classification_policy.meaning: PASS certifies numerical stability of the data-blind low-k matter/Weyl tangent map on the fixed v0.63 grid. PASS does not require a preferred sign or a large effect, is not an observational detection, and does not change any historical FAIL.

anti_tuning: After this predata file is committed, do not change the frozen cosmology, KB, tauH0, p, CLASS commit, Drude forcing orders, lambda set, fixed k grid, fixed z grid, response definitions, interpolation prescription, affinity metric, numerical gates, or sign-topology rules after reading v0.68 results. A FAIL is retained.
